name: search_knowledge
description: Semantic and keyword search across the user's knowledge bases; returns the most relevant passages for a natural-language query.

name: grep_knowledge
description: Exact substring / regex search across knowledge-base files; use when the user wants a literal string or pattern, not semantic relevance.

name: recall
description: Retrieve relevant stored memories about the user or project (preferences, facts, decisions).

name: remember
description: Persist a new memory fact about the user or project for later recall.

name: list_skills
description: List the skills currently available to load.

name: load_skill
description: Load a specific named skill's full instructions into context.

name: list_knowledge_bases
description: List the knowledge bases registered in Coffer.

name: read_document
description: Read one specific knowledge-base document by its id or path.
